headline: Wet, cool weather boosts Idaho ski resorts
pages: Another round of rain and snow is headed for Idaho, and cooler weather will stick around. KIVI reports it has been a winter-like week for ski resorts, with more than two feet of snow at Bogus Basin, 30 inches at Tamarack and 15 inches at Sun Valley. Sunday morning brings more precipitation to the Treasure Valley and central mountains, while Twin Falls should stay dry. Valley highs will be in the 40s and climb back to the 50s by next weekend, with a chance of showers Thursday. Outlooks run warmer than normal but not like last year. More showers are expected heading into December, which matters because southern Idaho's drought conditions have carried over from last year. Source: KIVI.
